title: Juicy Midnight Argentinian Mascarpone Empanadas
description: Tender empanadas filled with earthy, creamy mascarpone and served with a sweet fig compote. These empanadas cater to late-night cravings and are suitable for flexitarian diets.
instructions: Combine flour and salt in a large bowl, and then add the cold butter, using a pastry blender or your fingertips to work it into the flour until it resembles coarse crumbs.
Gradually add ice water, stirring with a fork until the dough just comes together in a ball.
Turn the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5-7 minutes, until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces, and roll each piece into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Place a tablespoon of mascarpone cheese in the center of each circle, leaving a 1-inch border around the edges.
Fold the dough in half over the filling, pressing the edges together with a fork to seal the empanada.
Brush the tops with egg and bake at 375°F for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Meanwhile, cook the fig jam in a small saucepan over medium heat until warmed through.
To serve, place the empanadas on a plate and drizzle with fig jam.
